why: Second build round for pipe slice 1 in next/ (docs/plan/quests/pipe-PLAN.md), from the tests step's head 0187d9e, to make O2 in runtime/PipeTest.ts green ('a restart sends again from seq 0: expected undefined to be +0'). Seen red here twice in three runs at 0187d9e. The tests step's reading held: when a crash's restart backoff has passed inside the crash's own call, the journal runs exit, down, start and checkpoint to idle and adopts the new life, and setAlarm then returns at its 'loading supplies the wake' branch (running, live null, nothing due), while the failed call loads nothing; so the new life never runs its init, owes no first send and sets no wake, until some later letter comes. When the backoff has not passed, the alarm's due finishes the restart and loads the life, and O2 is green. That is a runner bug for any restarted program with a first send or a timer, not only pipes. Fix in runtime/Runner.ts continueRecovery: when a recovery that was working ends with a new life in place and none loaded, arm the alarm at now, so the due loads it, the same path the timed restart takes. On the Worker the alarm is the Process object's saved storage alarm, whose handler calls due, so it holds there with no Project wake; when the same call goes on to load the life (ready in a restart request, an open, a letter, or a due), ready's own setAlarm sets the real next wake or clears it.
